environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on EC2 instance with public IP, ALB with TCP passthrough on port 8443, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on 8443. No CDN or request signing. Clients connect directly via ws://public-ip:8443/ws

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, SG ingress 0.0.0.0/0:8443
config.auth: none - WebSocket upgrade has no authentication
